Title: We bridge the translational gap between business problems and deeptech

Published Time: Thu, 09 Jul 2026 07:36:47 GMT

Markdown Content:
P

Plotch.ai

Problem-first Deeptech

We take your business and research challenges and solve it hands-on — working alongside your team, end to end.

Underneath, we run on **Groclake**, our proprietary engine for problem orchestration and production delivery.

The problems we're built for

## You don't need to know if your problem is solvable by "quantum" or "AI."

We find the best solver for your business or research challenge.

Optimization

Too many combinations for brute force to finish in time. Routing, allocation, portfolio construction, production mix, experiment design.

[Is this your problem? Let's find out →](https://plotch.ai/#contact)

Risk & simulation

Outcomes that depend on correlated, uncertain variables you can't fully model with a spreadsheet — financial exposure or physical/chemical systems alike.

[Is this your problem? Let's find out →](https://plotch.ai/#contact)

Scheduling & constraints

Conflicting requirements across time, people, or capacity that classical solvers choke on past a certain scale.

[Is this your problem? Let's find out →](https://plotch.ai/#contact)

Search across large spaces

Finding the right answer inside a space too large to check exhaustively — configurations, matches, or candidate structures.

[Is this your problem? Let's find out →](https://plotch.ai/#contact)

Discovery & simulation (research)

Open scientific questions where the search space is a molecule, a material, or a system too complex to simulate classically — the kind of problem that starts as "we don't know yet," not "we need this optimized."

[Is this your problem? Let's find out →](https://plotch.ai/#contact)

The pathway

## From problem to working answer

01

Engage and Evaluate

We start with your problem, described in your language, not ours — whether that's an operational bottleneck or an open research question. No quantum background required on your side. Deliverable: a written problem diagnosis and a call on whether this is worth pursuing at all — sometimes the honest answer is "not yet," and we'll say so.

02

Formulate and Model together

This is the part almost nobody else does well. We pair our translation specialists with your domain experts — the people who actually understand the portfolio, the network, the schedule — and co-design a precise, solvable formulation of the problem. This is the actual bottleneck in the industry right now, and it's where we spend most of our effort.

03

Execute and Refine

We run the formulation on the best solver available today — usually classical or hybrid, because that's what's actually ready — and wire it into your operations. If and when quantum hardware clears the bar for your specific problem, it swaps in underneath without you re-building anything. This is what Groclake, our engine, handles quietly in the background.

The people behind the work

## The qualified talent that bridges the gap

Every engagement is staffed from **QPool**, our global network of quantum researchers, mathematicians, and physicists — plus our own AI and delivery engineers. They're people who can deeply understand an industry's structural challenges, like portfolio risk or credit scoring, and translate them into solvable formulations.

That formulation work runs on Groclake, so every project builds on real infrastructure from day one, not a blank page. A sample of what QPool has worked on recently:

Portfolio and risk optimization for financial services

Supply chain routing and scheduling at enterprise scale

New material and molecule simulation for R&D teams

Credit and underwriting model formulation

Hybrid classical-quantum optimization for logistics and production

Quantum-ready formulation for early-stage research programs
